The depot was Southgate. I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

That comes from two of Priyanka's posts in the channel on 2025-09-03. During the outage she wrote that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident she wrote that Southgate had cleared the backlog. Tobias is a member of that channel, so he can see both posts.

The thread doesn't give a street address or any other site details, and I told him so. I also couldn't find any shared account files that would say more about the site.
